scenes.description: Singing and Playing Ukulele in Music Club
Thinking and Playing Board Games in Chess Club
Drawing Cute Animals in Craft and Art Club

character_line.en: After-school clubs are starting! Which club do you like best?
character_line.zh: 放學後的社團活動開始了！你最喜歡哪一個社團呢？

options.en: I like the music club best!

options.hint: 說出你感興趣的社團，比如「music club」喔！
告訴 Benny 你放學後最想去體驗哪個社團活動！

character_line.en: Listen to the happy music! Can you sing a song with me?
character_line.zh: 聽這個快樂的音樂！你可以跟我合唱一首歌嗎？

options.en: Yes, let us sing a happy song together!
options.zh: 好啊，我們一起唱一首快樂的歌！

options.hint: 在音樂社裡，說「let us sing together」一起唱歌！
開心地和 Benny 一起合唱動聽的兒歌吧！

character_line.en: Welcome to chess club! Do you like playing board games?
character_line.zh: 歡迎來到西洋棋社！你喜歡玩桌上益智遊戲嗎？

options.en: Yes, chess is fun and helps us think!
options.zh: 是的，下棋很好玩而且幫助我們動腦思考！

options.hint: 下棋可以動腦，用「chess is fun and helps us think」回答！
回答 Benny 你喜不喜歡下棋挑戰益智遊戲！

character_line.en: It is your turn! Which chess piece will you move?
character_line.zh: 輪到你走了！你想要移動哪一顆棋子呢？

options.en: I move the white knight forward!
options.zh: 我把白色的騎士往前走！

options.en: I wash my hands with soap.
options.hint: 下棋走棋時，可以說「I move the white knight forward」喔！
認真思考後，告訴 Benny 你的走法吧！

character_line.en: Look at the craft table! What cute animal are you drawing?
character_line.zh: 看手作社的桌子！你正在畫什麼可愛的動物呢？

options.en: I am drawing a cute fluffy bunny!
options.zh: 我正在畫一隻毛茸茸的可愛小兔子！

options.hint: 手作社畫小動物，說「I am drawing a cute bunny」喔！
跟 Benny 分享你正在創作的可愛小動物插圖吧！

character_line.en: Having fun hobbies makes every afternoon so special!
character_line.zh: 擁有好玩的興趣嗜好，讓每個下午都好充實特別！

options.en: Yes, I love exploring new hobbies!
options.zh: 沒錯，我好喜歡探索新興趣！

options.hint: 表達對社團活動的熱愛，說「I love exploring new hobbies!」！
開心地和 Benny 總結今天在社團的豐富收穫吧！
